requisito: Simulates a sequence of "PUT:istante:chiave" and "GET:istante:chiave" commands on a cache with lifetime ttl (an entry created or refreshed at t0 expires as soon as istante - t0 >= ttl; each command purges expired entries first). Returns "non valido" if operazioni is null or empty or ttl <= 0; otherwise returns the active entry count, hits over GET requests, and the hit percentage rounded to one decimal place.

difetti.indizio: Look at how expired entries are removed from the cache list.
difetti.spiegazione: Calling cache.Remove(voce) while iterating cache with foreach modifies the collection during enumeration and throws InvalidOperationException as soon as an entry expires.

difetti.indizio: Check the condition testing whether the key to update is already present in cache.
difetti.spiegazione: Using indice > 0 instead of indice >= 0 excludes the first element (index 0): instead of refreshing it, PUT inserts a duplicate entry into the list.

difetti.indizio: Look at the expression computing the final hit percentage.
difetti.spiegazione: hits, 100, and richieste are all int, so integer division truncates the decimal part (for example, 37.5 becomes 37) before assigning to double.

difetti.indizio: Look at how each string in operazioni is read at the start of the loop.
difetti.spiegazione: Calling raw!.Trim() without checking whether raw is null or empty first throws NullReferenceException as soon as a null entry is present.

difetti.indizio: Check the condition deciding when an entry has reached its expiration time.
difetti.spiegazione: The strict inequality istante - CreatoA > ttl leaves an entry active at the exact expiration moment (difference equal to ttl), when by specification it should already be removed.

difetti.indizio: Look at the denominator used to compute the hit percentage.
difetti.spiegazione: The percentage divides by operazioni.Length (which includes PUT commands too) instead of richieste (GET requests only).
